answer: The karst multiplier is published, charged in nectar, and river lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 3 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 2255 identities would post 612 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
